title: F1: Ferrari chief furious after Leclerc, Hamilton clash again

blocks.text: Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur lambasted Charles Leclerc for a “lack of respect” after the Monegasque driver’s latest clash with teammate Lewis Hamilton torpedoed the Italian team’s Las Vegas Grand Prix. Vasseur was left furious after Leclerc collided with Hamilton on lap 38 in Las Vegas — just weeks after the drivers had been told that the team must come first after clashing at the Mexico Grand Prix. Leclerc was subsequently hit with a 10-second penalty after an FIA Stewards inquiry and finished in 10th, while Hamilton finished seventh.
